jobs.description:
Our client, an innovative player in mobility and logistics technologies, is currently looking for a NodeJS Engineer.

Our client operates in the tech sector, developing digital solutions that connect vehicles, data, and users within a smart ecosystem.

With an international presence, the group is experiencing strong growth and collaborates with major players in the transportation and logistics industry.

The Belgian entity, based in Leuven, remains a human-sized structure offering a dynamic environment where technological innovation meets real-world impact.
NodeJS Engineer | The Role :
As a NodeJS Engineer, you will be part of a multidisciplinary team composed of developers, data specialists, product managers, and IT experts.

You will contribute to the design and development of software solutions aimed at optimizing fleet management and improving operational performance.

This is a key position within the organization, where you will be involved in the full development lifecycle, from business analysis to development, implementation, and maintenance.

NodeJS Engineer | Your Profile :
• You have at least 5 years of experience in NodeJS (JavaScript/TypeScript)
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in IT
• Tech stack: NodeJS, JavaScript/TypeScript, REST, SQL
• French: native / English: fluent
• You have experience working in an agile environment and across the full development lifecycle

Are you passionate about IT and dealing with customers at all levels? Do you have basic hardware/software break-fix experience?

If so, then we would like to discuss your next career move!

We are always looking for IT Support Engineers to join our dynamic Technical Resource Group team.

You can choose to have different assignments at different locations with several of our customers as a mobile engineer or you can choose to be on-site based at one of our key customers.

For our mobile positions we're looking for people in the Brussels area and the Brussels-Antwerp area.

 

What you will do

Working as part of a dynamic team you will be providing 1st and 2nd line on-site user support. This includes analyse incidents, problems & service requests, propose solutions and help implementing them. You will also be responsible for any escalation and follow up.

Some of the daily activities are:

• End users support
• Troubleshooting incidents, software and hardware
• Resolution of software and hardware issues (laptop, desktop, printers)
• Installation and configuration of laptops
• Software issues for inhouse applications
• Organizing, analyzing and handling of tickets in the IT ticketing tool
• Quick analysis and incident management, close collaboration with expert team
• Preparing new and repaired hardware
• Staging laptops and PC's with SCCM
• Windows 10 troubleshooting
• Preparation of conference rooms and management meetings
• Physical installation of cabling, monitors, dockings, pc's, printers,...

What you will need

The ideal candidate will be an expert in dealing with customers at all levels; you bring hands-on technical skills as well as great interpersonal skills.

• Previous knowledge of Microsoft Applications
• Previous experience of supporting Mobile devices and hand-held devices
• Good administrative experience, attention to detail, ensures accuracy of data, provides data for reporting and processing of information
• Previous experience working in a corporate IT environment is an asset
• Excellent customer facing and communication skills; adaptable and welcoming of change and communicating change to customers
• Excellent time management and organisational skills
• Willing to take initiative and be hands-on
• Very good communication skills, both verbal and written in English and good command of Dutch and/or French
• Driver's license B

Join a leading international organization undergoing a major digital and data transformation while contributing to critical infrastructure and sustainability challenges.

As Data Manager, you will define and drive the enterprise-wide data strategy, ensuring strong governance, data quality, security, and regulatory compliance. You will play a key role in unlocking business value through data, analytics, and AI across operations, finance, ESG, and corporate functions.

• Define and execute the company's enterprise-wide data strategy.
• Establish data governance frameworks, ownership models, and quality standards.
• Develop and oversee the roadmap, programs, and projects required to implement the data strategy.
• Drive data-enabled transformation across business functions.
• Ensure compliance with regulatory, security, and critical infrastructure requirements.
• Build the foundations required for advanced analytics and AI adoption.
• Lead and develop a team of 10-15 experts
• Engage and influence senior stakeholders, including executive leadership and board-level decision-makers.
• Promote a data-driven culture across the organization.

Profile

• Master's degree required.
• Minimum 10 years of professional experience, including at least 5 years in senior leadership positions within Data, IT, Digital, or Transformation environments.
• Proven experience in deploying enterprise-wide data governance frameworks and major data transformation initiatives.
• Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
• Demonstrated ability to define roadmaps and drive large-scale organizational change.
• Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate complex topics clearly to executive audiences.
• Experience within industry, infrastructure, utilities, energy, manufacturing, or other regulated sectors is highly valued.
• Exposure to OT/IT environments, cybersecurity, critical infrastructure, SCADA, telemetry, AI, or NIS2-related topics is an asset.
• Strong people management and transversal leadership skills.
• Humble, resilient, influential, and able to navigate complex environments with calm and credibility.
• Fluent in English and either French or Dutch.

Join an innovative technology team developing AI powered digital solutions. Work on large-scale applications, modern cloud technologies, and impactful projects.

Are you passionate about building scalable applications and leveraging the latest technologies to create impactful digital solutions? Join an innovative engineering team where you'll contribute to the development of AI-powered products used by a large and growing user base.

 

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will work on a variety of initiatives, ranging from continuous product improvements to large-scale strategic projects. You'll play a key role in designing, developing and maintaining modern web applications while helping shape intelligent conversational experiences powered by AI.

Working in a cross-functional Agile team, you will collaborate closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Functional Analysts and fellow developers to deliver high-quality software that meets both technical and business objectives.
Role
• Design, develop and maintain scalable full-stack applications.
• Translate functional requirements into robust technical solutions.
• Develop and maintain backend services and APIs.
• Build intuitive and responsive frontend applications.
• Improve and expand existing codebases while maintaining high quality standards.
• Leverage AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), to build smarter and more efficient solutions.
• Integrate applications with backend systems and third-party services.
• Contribute to cloud-native architectures using modern development practices.
• Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams throughout the complete software development lifecycle.
• Continuously improve performance, maintainability and security of the applications.
ProfileMust-have
• 5+ years of experience as a Full Stack or Backend Software Developer.
• Strong experience with Python.
• Solid knowledge of Java (Spring is a strong advantage).
• Experience with Git and modern software development practices.
• Good understanding of CI/CD principles.
• Experience building cloud-native applications, microservices and RESTful APIs.
• Hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI.
• Experience integrating APIs and backend systems.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication skills in English.
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within Agile teams.
 
Nice to have
• Experience with Docker, Podman or Kubernetes.
• Familiarity with AWS or other cloud platforms.
• Experience with AI-driven development tools and agentic workflows.
• Passion for writing clean, maintainable and high-quality code.
 
Soft Skills
• Proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
• Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
• Eager to learn and continuously improve.
• Flexible and adaptable in a fast-paced environment.
• Able to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high quality.
• Team player with a collaborative attitude.

Our client is a fast-growing Belgian company operating in the food industry. To support its continued growth and digital transformation, we are currently looking for an Application Support Analyst to strengthen their IT Applications team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on professional who enjoys working closely with end users, optimizing business applications, and contributing to the continuous improvement of business processes.

As an Application Analyst / IT Support, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth operation and continuous improvement of the company's business applications.

Acting as the first point of contact for application-related issues, you will support users, coordinate improvements, and contribute to the evolution of the organization's application landscape:

• Provide first-line support to internal users for business applications.
• Analyze and resolve application-related incidents, escalating where necessary.
• Manage and maintain business applications.
• Follow up on change requests, software updates, and application improvement initiatives.
• Contribute to reporting, data management, and process optimization projects.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners across multiple sites.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives within the IT applications environment.

Profile

• Bachelor's or Master's degree, or equivalent through experience.
• Minimum 2 to 3 years of experience in application support, application management, functional analysis, or a similar role.
• Experience working with ERP systems.
• Knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain Management (FSCM) and/or Navision is considered a strong asset.
• Experience with or interest in Power BI, reporting solutions, and EDI/API integrations is a plus.
• Service-oriented mindset with a genuine willingness to help end users.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Proactive, hands-on, and capable of taking ownership.
• Team player with excellent communication skills.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.

As a Senior Information Security Officer, you are the strategic leader who defines, drives and strengthens Luminus’ cybersecurity vision across the entire organization. You ensure that our IT, OT, business operations, subsidiaries and affiliates are protected against evolving cyber threats while supporting our mission to deliver reliable and secure energy services to millions of customers.

What you'll do

• You define and implement a company-wide cybersecurity strategy aligned with Luminus’ business objectives, risk appetite and regulatory requirements.
• Identify, assess, prioritize and report cybersecurity risks to executive leadership and governance bodies, while ensuring compliance with regulations such as NIS, GDPR and other applicable cybersecurity frameworks.
• You develop and maintain security policies, standards and governance frameworks, and ensure their effective adoption across the organization, subsidiaries and affiliates.
• Build and manage the cybersecurity roadmap, driving initiatives that strengthen resilience, compliance and operational efficiency while building on the strong foundations already in place.
• You work closely with IT, OT, business leaders, the Data Protection Officer, security operations teams and the Information Security Forum to integrate security into key activities and create alignment across the organization.
• Represent Luminus towards regulators, authorities, auditors and external partners, while chairing the Information Security Forum and influencing stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

What you'll bring

• You have at least 8 years of experience in information security, including a minimum of 5 years in a leadership role.
• Extensive expertise in cybersecurity governance, risk management, security technologies, regulatory compliance and the ability to translate security requirements into business value.
• You communicate confidently with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and can clearly explain security risks, priorities and recommendations to senior management, directors and subsidiary leaders.
• Strong influencing, organizational and prioritization skills, allowing you to build consensus, challenge stakeholders when needed and drive security improvements across a complex organization.
• You hold a relevant master's degree or have acquired equivalent expertise through professional experience.
• Recognized certifications such as CISSP, CISM and ISO 27001 Lead Implementer are required. A good understanding of IT and OT environments, risk management and the energy sector is a strong asset. Fluent English and French are required.

jobs.occupation: Business Analyst IAM - IT Production Security - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

You’ll be the go-to expert in Privileged Access Management (PAM) within our IAM Evolution Squad, driving the security and efficiency of access governance at BNP Paribas Fortis. 

Your mission? Design, implement, and optimize PAM solutions using CyberArk and SailPoint, ensuring compliance with strict banking regulations while collaborating with IT, security, and business teams.

This is your chance to shape the future of secure access in a global bank, working in a hybrid setup (50% remote, 50% on-site in Brussels) with a skilled, multicultural team of 10 specialists.

 

AND IN DETAIL

What You’ll Own:

• Lead PAM Strategy & Execution: As the Privileged Access Management (PAM) Subject Matter Expert (SME), you’ll own the design, implementation, and optimization of CyberArk-based solutions, ensuring they meet security, compliance, and operational needs.
• Strengthen Access Governance: Work closely with IAM, IT Security, Compliance, and Risk teams to align access policies with BNP Paribas Fortis standards and regulatory requirements.
• Drive Process Improvement: Use KPIs and data-driven insights to refine access management workflows, reducing risks and enhancing efficiency.
• Collaborate & Train: Partner with cross-functional teams to implement best practices and upskill colleagues on PAM and IAM protocols.
• Innovate with Cutting-Edge Tools: Leverage SailPoint, CyberArk, and ServiceNow to build a scalable, adaptive identity framework.
 

Why It Matters: 
 You’re not just managing access, you’re protecting critical banking systems, ensuring compliance, and enabling secure, seamless operations for thousands of users. 

Your work will directly impact how we mitigate risks, enforce policies, and future-proof our security infrastructure.

Your Team & Environment:

• A squad of 10 (Business Analysts, Security Officers, Product Owner, Scrum Master) based in Montagne-Du-Parc, Brussels.
• A hybrid work model (50% remote, 50% on-site) for flexibility and collaboration.
• A culture of innovation, where you’ll help transition access governance into a dynamic, compliance-first, AI-augmented capability.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Non-Negotiables (Must-Haves)

• 10+ years in security technology, with deep expertise in:
• Identity & Access Management (IAM)
• Privileged Access Management (PAM), CyberArk experience mandatory
• Segregation of Duties (SoD) & Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) 
• Hands-on experience with:
• SailPoint, Cloud (IaaS/PaaS), ServiceNow, Process Management Tools
• Designing requirements, specifications, and use cases 
• CISSP Certification (or equivalent) 
• Languages:
• English (fluent, written & spoken)
• Dutch and/or French is an asset
 

What Sets You Apart

• Analytical & Conceptual Thinker: You break down complex problems and design practical, scalable solutions. 
• Strong Negotiator & Influencer : You align stakeholders, drive decisions, and get buy-in for critical security initiatives.
• Proactive & Resilient: You take ownership, adapt quickly, and deliver under pressure.
• Strict on Execution: You track progress meticulously and ensure no detail is overlooked
• Team Player in a Multicultural Setting: You collaborate smoothly with diverse, high-performing teams.

jobs.occupation: Asset Modeler IAM - IT Production Security - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

At BNP Paribas Fortis, Identity & Access Management (IAM) is where security meets innovation. We're transforming how the bank manages access rights, making it smarter, more secure, and future-proof.

As part of our IAM Evolution Squad, you'll help build a modern, compliance-driven identity framework using SailPoint and CyberArk.

You'll join a 10-person team of Business Analysts, Security Officers, Product Owner, and Scrum Master based in Montagne Du Parc.

Here, you won't just maintain security, you'll shape its future.

 

AND IN DETAIL

As our Privileged Access Management (PAM) Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll be the driving force behind designing, implementing, and optimizing our PAM solutions.

You'll ensure our security not only meets the highest standards but also evolves with the future.

 

What will you actually do?

• You'll develop and implement access policies that meet strict security and regulatory requirements. You'll guide the evolution of our IAM systems, working closely with IT and business teams to ensure security never comes at the expense of efficiency.
• You'll share your knowledge and train teams in best practices, because strong security starts with everyone who uses it. And you'll optimize processes using KPIs and continuous improvement because security is never truly "done".
• You'll collaborate with IAM specialists and cross-functional teams (IT Security, Infrastructure, Compliance, Risk) to strengthen our security controls. You'll make sure we're always one step ahead.
 

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

• You have a Bachelor’s/Master’s degree and are CISSP-certified (or have equivalent experience).
• You bring 10+ years of security experience, with deep knowledge of PAM (CyberArk) and a strong background in IAM, Segregation of Duties, and Role-Based Access Control. You're familiar with SailPoint and Cloud (IaaS/PaaS).
 

But what really sets you apart?

• And you love working in multicultural teams, because diversity is your strength.

jobs.occupation: IT & Cyber Permanent Control Officer - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

Join BNP Paribas Fortis as an IT Operational Permanent Control (OPC) Specialist At BNP Paribas Fortis, our Cyber Security division unites the Centre of Excellence (CoE) Security and IT Filiere Production Security BE to design, implement, and maintain robust security solutions. 
Our mission? To foster a trustworthy, secure environment for both our colleagues and clients.

We’re seeking a proactive professional to join our IT Operational Permanent Control (OPC) team, a key function within Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC). Here, you’ll play a pivotal role in helping IT and Business Units navigate operational risks tied to IT and Cyber Security, while reinforcing an adaptive, resilient control framework across the bank.

 

AND IN DETAIL

• Identification and assessment of risks: You’ll analyse data from risk systems, reports, and governance bodies, turning complex information into practical, risk-based insights. Your conclusions will help leaders make informed decisions.
• Controls Execution & Reporting: You’ll interpret, adapt, and run control tests (compliance, fraud, outsourcing, etc.), then report findings to the CIO, ensuring controls align with IT’s strategic priorities.
• Regulatory & Internal Reporting: You’ll prepare precise, high-impact reports for the Internal Control Committee (ExCo), regulators (NBB/BNB, ECB), and Group entities (CDF/IT Group), shaping risk discussions at the highest level.
• Procedure Governance: As the gatekeeper for IT risk and security procedures, you’ll ensure they’re up to date, accessible, and visible, keeping our compliance framework structured and resilient.
• Governance Body Support: Acting as NAC secretary for major IT initiatives, you’ll track stakeholder conditions (Business & Functions), driving accountability and alignment in high-impact projects.
• Risk & Control Self-Assessment (RCSA): You’ll conduct the annual RCSA for all IT risk categories, using the RISK ORM methodology to assess risks, incidents, and recommendations, giving a full picture of IT’s risk profile, including external threats.
• Regulatory Reporting – IT Risk Questionnaire: You’ll coordinate the bank’s response to the ECB’s IT Risk questionnaire (via Group) and the NBB’s BNP Paribas Fortis reporting, ensuring submissions are accurate, regulator-ready, and endorsed by the CISO/CIO.
• Compliance Controls Execution: You’ll run IT-wide compliance checks (awareness, ethics, etc.), report findings to the IT Management Team, and drive remediation where needed, ensuring actions are documented and evidenced.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Background & Experience

• A Master’s degree in IT, economics, or engineering, with a strong IT foundation.
• 10+ years of experience, including at least 5 years in Risk or IT whether in financial services, consulting, or another regulated industry.
  
What You Bring to the Table

• IT & Security Process Insight: You understand how IT and security technologies integrate into risk and operational frameworks and where the gaps might be.
• Risk Assessment Skills: Hands-on experience in identifying and evaluating IT and cyber risks, with a practical (not just theoretical) approach.
• Regulatory & Standards Know-How: Familiarity with frameworks like EBA guidelines, DORA, ISO 27001, or NIST and the ability to apply them in real-world IT risk and compliance scenarios.
• Control Design & Testing: You can translate regulations and policies into effective controls and know how to test whether they actually work.
• Agile Mindset: Experience with Agile methodologies in a risk or control environment is a plus, but adaptability matters most.
• Process Thinking: You quickly grasp end-to-end processes, spot risks, and propose practical solutions without getting lost in bureaucracy.
• Clear Communication: Whether it’s a report for executives or a presentation for regulators, you distill complex topics into concise, actionable messages.
• Stakeholder Alignment: You bridge the gap between technical teams, business units, and regulators keeping everyone aligned without losing sight of compliance and risk goals.
• Collaboration: You thrive in cross-functional teams, working smoothly with colleagues and partners to execute risk and control initiatives.
  
Practicalities

• Languages: Fluent in French or Dutch, with strong English (written and spoken).
• Tools: Comfortable with SharePoint, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
• Nice-to-have: Experience with RISK 360 is a plus, but not a must.

jobs.occupation: AI Innovation Specialist | Welcome in AI World
jobs.description:
Drive AI innovation in a global organization, turning business ideas into impactful AI solutions while shaping the future of digital transformation.

Join a leadinginternational risk management and financial services organizationwith a strong global presence and a collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence.

 

We are looking for anAI Integration Analystto accelerate the adoption of Artificial Intelligence across the organization. In this role, you will identify high-value AI opportunities, translate business needs into practical implementation plans, and support the successful deployment and adoption of AI solutions.
AI Innovation Specialist - What's the job about ?
• Identify and prioritizeAI use cases through workshops with business and IT stakeholders.
• Translate business needsinto practical AI and automation solutions with measurable impact.
• Coordinate and supportthe implementation and integration of AI initiatives across the organization.
• Promote AI adoptionthrough communication, training, and user support, with a focus on Agentic AI.
• Collaboratewith Security, Compliance, and international teams to ensure secure and compliant AI solutions.
• Drive AI maturityby contributing to capability building and continuous improvement initiatives.
AI Innovation Specialist - Who Are You ?
• Experience inAI,digital transformation, project management or process improvement, ideally within a regulated environment.
• Strong understanding ofGenerative AI,Agentic AI, and their practical business applications.
• Knowledge ofAPIs, data flows, and system integration concepts.
• Experience supportingchange management, user adoption, training, and stakeholder engagement.
• Good understanding ofsecurity, compliance, and governance considerations related to AI solutions.
• Fluent inDutchandEnglish; French is considered an advantage.

About the job
 

TMC is looking for multiple experienced IT Functional Analysts to join a dynamic IT environment responsible for the development and maintenance of business-critical applications. You will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and IT teams, translating functional requirements into clear and structured solutions while ensuring alignment with business objectives. The role offers the opportunity to work within a large-scale enterprise environment undergoing continuous digital evolution and modernization.

The ideal candidates have at least 4 years of experience (of which at least 2 years as a Functional Analyst), preferably within the insurance sector, and is comfortable engaging directly with business stakeholders. Experience with underwriting processes in Non-Life insurance is highly valued, while exposure to claims management, document management, SQL, project methodologies (Prince2), and test management practices (TMAP) is considered an asset. Strong analytical thinking, excellent communication skills, a structured approach, and a customer-oriented mindset are essential for success in this role.

 

As part of the team, you will be responsible for analysing business needs, designing functional solutions, preparing and executing integration tests, validating deliverables, and supporting the implementation of new functionalities. You will collaborate closely with developers, technical analysts, project managers, and business representatives to ensure high-quality solutions that meet user expectations. This is a long-term assignment based in the Brussels region, offering a hybrid working model with a combination of on-site presence and remote work. We are looking for people who master at least 1 national language, and English.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

Build the backbone of our digital future as a Web Infrastructure Architect in our Agile Production Services (APS) tribe. Based in Brussels (HQ), you’ll design, secure, and optimize the high-performance web infrastructure that powers our business, working alongside a diverse, skilled team to push boundaries in scalability, security, and cloud innovation.

If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges and shaping enterprise-grade web solutions, this is where your expertise will make an impact.

 

AND IN DETAIL

You won’t just maintain systems, you’ll engineer resilience, performance, and security into every layer of our web infrastructure. 
Here’s how:

Design with precision

• Craft Detailed Technical Designs (DTDs) that turn business needs into scalable, future-proof architectures.
• Define reference architectures to standardize how we build, deploy, and secure web applications.
Solve deep technical problems

• Debug complex incidents using APM tools, logs, and traces, finding root causes and fixing them for good.
• Optimize performance by analyzing application flows, bottlenecks, and resource usage (think: WebSphere tuning, Kubernetes scaling, TLS handshakes).
Secure and modernize

• Harden our web hosting (WebSphere, Tomcat, IIS) and security layers (F5 WAF, ISVA, API Gateway, oAuth2, HSM).
• Lead cloud migration and optimization (IaaS/PaaS) while keeping costs and risks in check.
• Collaborate and influence
• Work closely with DevOps, Security, and Development teams to ensure designs are practical, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards.
• Mentor and guide, your expertise will help raise the bar for the entire team.
• Keep us ahead of the curve
• Monitor, measure, and improve, proactively spotting risks and opportunities in our web infrastructure.
• Drive cost-efficiency initiatives, from right-sizing resources to decommissioning legacy systems.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

We’re looking for someone who lives and breathes web infrastructure with the skills to back it up.

 

Core Technical Skills (Must-Have)

• 5+ years in infrastructure architecture, with hands-on experience in:
• Web Application Hosting: WebSphere, Kubernetes, IIS, Tomcat
• Web Security: F5 WAF, ISVA, API Gateway, HSM, oAuth2, TLS
• Cloud Environments: IaaS/PaaS (design, migration, optimization)
• Performance troubleshooting: APM tools, logging, tracing, capacity planning
• Incident analysis: Root-cause investigation for web infrastructure issues
 

How You Work

• Analytical and data-driven: You don’t guess, you measure, analyze, and optimize.
• Collaborative: You thrive in cross-functional teams (Security, DevOps, Development) and can explain complex tech simply.
• Proactive and pragmatic: You spot problems before they happen and solve them efficiently.
 

Nice-to-Haves

• Languages: Fluent in English (mandatory); French/Dutch is a plus.
• Education/Certs: Master’s degree (or equivalent experience). TOGAF, ITIL, or Agile certifications are a bonus.
 

Soft Skills

• A team player who’s autonomous, adaptable, and ready to tackle challenges in a fast-moving environment.

• Lead, coach, and inspire a multidisciplinary team of approximately 12 professionals, including application analysts, developers, project managers, as well as a Salesforce Technical Architect and Release Manager.
• Foster a collaborative, motivated, and high-performing team culture while supporting the professional growth of each team member through effective coaching and development.
• Prioritize team activities and ensure the right balance between workload, resources, and business priorities.
• Own and manage the portfolio of customer-related IT projects, translating the company's Customer Strategy into a clear and actionable project roadmap.
• Work closely with business stakeholders and enterprise architects to define and communicate the future vision of the customer application domain.
• Ensure successful project delivery within agreed scope, budget, quality, and timelines.
• Oversee the maintenance, enhancement, and support of the applications within your domain, ensuring high availability and an excellent user experience.
• Organize and optimize the handling of incidents, change requests, and service requests in line with departmental processes and agreed service levels (SLAs).
• Proactively monitor the health and performance of business-critical applications.
• Provide functional leadership to the Salesforce Technical Architect and Release Manager, ensuring governance, consistency, knowledge sharing, and the adoption of best practices across all Salesforce teams.
• Manage the budgets and supplier contracts required to deliver your team's objectives.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and stay informed about emerging technologies and industry trends.

Profile

• Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Business, or another relevant scientific discipline.
• At least 5 years of experience managing application development teams or leading complex application projects.
• Proven experience delivering customer-facing digital solutions within an enterprise complex environment.
• Languages: French, Dutch and English
• Hands-on experience implementing or managing CRM solutions.
• Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and/or Field Service is a strong advantage.
• Familiarity with Enterprise Architect, JIRA, Planview, Omnitracker, and AI-driven solutions is considered a plus.
• You bring strong leadership and coaching skills.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
• Strong analytical and organizational skills.

Your role is structured around four main areas, each contributing to the stability and continuous improvement of the IT infrastructure.

License Management (20%)

You will be responsible for managing software licenses, including Microsoft subscriptions and on-premises licensing, Oracle, VMware, Apple, and other software vendors, monitoring software acquisitions, renewals, and retirements, ensuring license compliance and validating software usage and requests.

Contract Management (20%)

• Managing support and maintenance contract renewals.
• Monitoring contractual commitments, service costs, and vendor performance.
• Contributing to the preparation of technical specifications for new procurement processes.
• Ensuring suppliers comply with technical requirements and agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Data Center & Infrastructure (10%)

• Oversee the day-to-day management of data center facilities operated by external partners.
• Coordinate maintenance and operational activities.
• Assess physical infrastructure requirements, including power, cooling, and rack capacity.
• Manage the installation, relocation, and decommissioning of IT equipment.
Capacity & Asset Management (50%)

• Manage the complete lifecycle of hardware and software assets.
• Coordinate the retirement, redeployment, or resale of IT equipment.
• Maintain an accurate IT asset inventory and ensure the Configuration Management Database remains up to date.
• Optimize asset utilization and manage hardware stock levels.
• Prepare and monitor CAPEX and OPEX budgets related to IT infrastructure.
• Forecast infrastructure capacity requirements over a 1- to 4-year horizon in close collaboration with the Architecture team.
• Ensure compliance with IT equipment standards and the corporate IT service catalogue.

Profile

• Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Engineering/Business Administration with an IT specialization, or equivalent through relevant professional experience.
• Proven experience in IT infrastructure, capacity planning, IT asset management, software license management, and vendor contract management.
• Solid understanding of data center environments, ITIL processes, IT asset inventories, and CMDB management.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft, Oracle, VMware, and Apple licensing models.
• Experience preparing and managing CAPEX and OPEX budgets.
• Strong understanding of enterprise IT environments, including virtualization, storage, databases, and Windows-based systems.
• Languages: French , Dutch and English
• Highly organized, structured, and detail-oriented.
• Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
• Excellent analytical abilities with a proactive approach to optimization and long-term planning.
• Able to work independently while taking ownership and responsibility.
• Clear communicator who enjoys collaborating in a professional and approachable manner.

Talencia is looking for a “Data Business Analyst” for one of its clients.

Location : Brussels

Start date : ASAP

Duration : Long term vision

 

Context :

We are looking for an experienced Data Business Analyst to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and Data Engineering teams. In this role, you will play a key part in translating business needs into scalable data solutions while supporting the transformation from an SAP-based landscape to a modern cloud data platform. You will contribute to both the maintenance of the current SAP BW environment and the evolution of the future data architecture.

Description :

As a Data Business Analyst, you will gather and analyse business requirements, translating them into functional and technical data specifications. You will design data mappings, transformation logic, and KPI definitions, while collaborating on conceptual and logical data models. Your responsibilities will also include SQL analysis, data profiling, and data quality assessments, as well as producing Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Specifications.
